title: Exact Optimal 3^k Generalized-Toffoli Decomposition, N-Independent Chebyshev Filters, and Minimax Advice for AC0 not subset BQAC0/qpoly
abstract: We sharpen three core quantitative ingredients in the recent unconditional separation AC^0 not subset BQAC^0/qpoly of Sun and Wang (arXiv:2611.34803v1). First (Theorem A), we improve the product-projection L1-norm upper bound for k generalized Toffoli gates from 18^k to the exact optimal constant 3^k (a 6^k exponential sharpening) via disjoint-gate factorization, 2x2 diagonal cancellation (m=1), Cauchy-Schwarz (m=2), and a real XY-parity expansion with a sum-of-squares bound 27 - 16(1-s)(1+s)^3 = (2s-1)^2(4s^2+12s+11) >= 0 (m>=3), and we prove a matching universal lower bound >= 3^k over all real and complex product-projection decompositions via a multiplicative dual witness W^{otimes k} on CCZ^{otimes k}, reducing the backward layer-peeling exponent from 1 + ln 18 < 4 to 1 + ln 3 < 2.1. Second (Theorem B), retaining the 1/r! prefix and 1/(R-r) scaling in the Chebyshev filter removes the spurious ln N factor from the degree completely (64.9x smaller at N=10^9, R=100, r=10) and collapses ln mu_N(q) from quadratic to linear in ln N (78.2x smaller analytically, 78.3x with exact prefix sum at N=10^9). Third (Theorem C), we establish the unique minimax optimal advice bias a* = M/(2M-1) and repair a clause-vs-literal conflation on H_n (M(H_n) <= n clauses rather than 3n), boosting the classical-advice advantage from 1/(12n) to >= 1/(4n-2). The algebraic cores are constructively formalized in Lean 4.35.0 (20 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), backed by an AST-audited zero-float exact rational verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates (QAC0-SHARP-CERT-1.0), and 51/51 passing tests.
